title: Projective-bundle pullback reflects isomorphism classes of base lines
statement: Let S be a scheme [def-pc-scheme] and E a quasi-coherent finite locally free module of constant positive rank r [def-amb-finite-locally-free-module]. Let p:P=Proj_S(Sym E)->S be the canonical projective bundle [def-trf-canonical-symmetric-graded-algebra]. For invertible O_S-modules N and Nprime [def-sc-invertible-module], if their pullbacks p^*N and p^*Nprime [def-pc-module-pullback] are isomorphic, then N and Nprime are isomorphic. This asserts reflection of isomorphism classes, with no degree or existence assertion for arbitrary modules on P.

proof.text: Write the positive rank as n+1. The finite locally free rank condition gives a covering by opens on which E is free of rank n+1. Refine an arbitrary neighbourhood intersected with a frame open by an affine open. Restriction composition and restriction of a free module preserve the frame, so affine opens on which E is free of this rank form a basis. This constructs the exact basis used below, without assuming intersections of affine opens are affine.

source.place: Tag 01C6; affine refinement as in Schemes, Tag 01IT.

proof.text: For standard projective space over Spec R with a finite nonempty coordinate type, the existing degree-zero twist cohomology calculation, O(0) isomorphic to O, H0 identified with global sections, and the constant-polynomial equivalence give a linear equivalence Gamma(P,O) with R for the module structure induced by the canonical structure map. A unital algebra free of rank one has bijective algebraMap: apply Mathlib Module.Free.bijective_algebraMap_of_finrank_eq_one and the linear equivalence. If R is the zero ring, its algebra is subsingleton and the same map is directly bijective. Transport this calculation from Spec Gamma(S,O) across an affine scheme isomorphism, using projective-space base change and the over-base equation. Thus the structure morphism of standard projective space over any affine scheme induces an isomorphism on global functions.

source.place: Lemma cohomology-projective-space-over-ring (Tag 01XS), degree zero; algebra fact: Mathlib/LinearAlgebra/Trace.lean, Module.Free.bijective_algebraMap_of_finrank_eq_one.

proof.text: The normalized symmetric-Proj chart-gluing theorem supplies open-base compatibility. On a frame affine V, identify the tensor pullback of E with its ordinary restriction using uniqueness of left adjoints, then apply the free comparison to the normalized quotient over V. This identifies its relative Proj with standard projective n-space over V, with the structure map preserved. The previous calculation makes its map on global functions an isomorphism. Compare the supplied open-base pullback square with the canonical morphism-restriction pullback square; the induced scheme isomorphism identifies this map with p.app V up to isomorphisms of section rings. Therefore p.app V is an isomorphism for every affine frame V. The canonical unit-module map O_S to p_*O_P has these component maps, so the basis criterion for isomorphisms of sheaves makes it an isomorphism. Equivalently p.app U is bijective on every base open U.

source.place: Remark 4.2.7, printed p.75; Stacks constructions.tex, Tags 01OA, 01OE; sheaves.tex, Lemma restrict-basis-equivalence (Tag 009O). The proved source API Scheme.Modules.isIso_of_bijective_app_of_basis implements the criterion for module sheaves.

proof.text: Let o:p_*O_P be isomorphic to O_S using the inverse of the preceding canonical unit isomorphism. The already proved ordinary invertible-module projection formula, with the upstairs module equal to O_P, gives p_*p^*N isomorphic to N and p_*p^*Nprime isomorphic to Nprime. Use the natural isomorphism from tensorPullback to the adjoint-defined pullback, obtained by uniqueness of left adjoints to p_*, to convert the supplied isomorphism to an ordinary-pullback isomorphism. Push it forward and compose with the two projection-formula identifications. This is the required isomorphism N with Nprime. Only the ordinary projection formula is used; its existing source declarations hold for arbitrary morphisms despite being recorded under the closed-immersion cohomology node.

lean.statement:
theorem projective_bundle_pullback_line_reflection (S : Scheme.{u}) (E : S.Modules)
    [E.IsQuasicoherent] (r : ℕ)
    [SheafOfModules.IsFiniteLocallyFreeOfRank.{u, u, u} E r] (hr : 0 < r)
    (N N' : S.Modules) (hN : N.IsInvertible) (hN' : N'.IsInvertible)
    (e : Nonempty ((tensorPullback
      (SymmetricAlgebraSheaf.gradedAlgebraData E).relProjHom).obj N ≅
        (tensorPullback (SymmetricAlgebraSheaf.gradedAlgebraData E).relProjHom).obj N')) :
    Nonempty (N ≅ N')
